_meta.note: Box SKUs are internal. No box code is ever emitted to Datex; every box explodes into bread material codes.
_meta.kraft_rule: BW_BFP qty = bread_units on the order. Add-on lines do not count.
_meta.rules_live_in: Shopify product metafield breadwright.explode_rule (type json, pinned). Written 2026-08-18. The bridge should read the rule off the product rather than hardcoding this file — a new box then needs no code change.
_meta.warehouse_code_metafield: breadwright.warehouse_code (json, pinned) on every non-box sellable product. datex_code null = the code does not exist yet; the bridge should reject the order rather than ship short.
